# Event Ability

Source: [9595](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/9595); edited 2026-08-30. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

Exact pinned API: [Event Ability](../../api/values/event-ability.md).

<a id="wiki-9595-n1"></a>

- Event Ability applies to elimination/final blow/damage/death/healing/knockback events.

<a id="wiki-9595-n2"></a>

- Article maintains a substantial known-bug table where some abilities return Null or another button; bleed may retain originating ability attribution.

Source limitations:

- Hero-specific table is explicitly bugged and patch-sensitive; Null is not evidence that no ability caused the event.

- Examples include Sombra virus DOT Null versus impact Ability 1, Illari secondary as primary, and many newer heroes returning Null; not retested.
